name: audio8
description: Audio8 TTS (unofficial) — 44.1kHz zero-shot voice cloning, runs on GPU in its own conda env
author: sapphire

client.label: Client only
client.help: use an Audio8 server on another computer; nothing downloads here

tts.description: Zero-shot voice cloning on your GPU, runs here, free. Bring a short clip and its transcript.

settings.label: Server port
settings.help: Local port for the Audio8 model server. Change needs a plugin toggle to restart the service.

settings.label: Default voice
settings.help: Voice name: a built-in, or one you added (user/audio8-voices/<name>.wav + <name>.txt). Used when the chat's voice isn't an Audio8 voice.

settings.label: Temperature
settings.help: Sampling temperature. Lower = steadier, higher = livelier. Model default 0.8.

settings.label: Stream in pieces (experimental)
settings.help: Off (recommended): each sentence group comes whole. On: speech is sent in short pieces as it's made, so the first words come sooner, but it costs more GPU time and adds small gaps between pieces.

settings.label: Client only
settings.help: Use an Audio8 server on another computer instead of this one: no environment, no model, no GPU here. Saving starts or stops this computer's server.

settings.label: Pairing string from the GPU computer
settings.help: On that computer run audio8-server.bat (Windows) or audio8-server.sh (Linux) and copy the pairing string it prints. Your voices are sent there once each, the first time they're used.
